_about: Live-site checks that override the aggregators. A posting whose URL is listed here is dropped from the feed and can't open a watchlist item. Add an entry whenever a company's own page disagrees with SimplifyJobs or vanshb03.

items.finding: Rivian's own careers site lists only Spring 2027 internships; Summer 2027 is not open. SimplifyJobs tagged these as Summer 2027.
